issues.legal_issue: Expenditure on maintaining immature, non-bearing rubber trees is deductible in computing agricultural income when the applicable plantation-expense test is no narrower than the test applied in the controlling precedent.
material_facts: The assessee claimed expenses for the maintenance and upkeep of immature, non-bearing rubber trees on its rubber plantation.
The agricultural income-tax tribunal and the High Court allowed the claimed expenditure, with the tribunal directing that expenses for forking and manuring the immature areas be ascertained.

The applicable deduction provision used wording that was the same as the provision considered in an earlier decision except for its closing phrase, which the Court regarded as more favourable to the assessee.
The earlier decision had decided the deductibility of expenditure for forking, manuring, and similar work on immature rubber trees.
issues.conclusion: The earlier decision governed the case, so the expenditure was deductible and the appeal was dismissed.
issues.legal_principle: Section 5(e) of the Madras Plantations Agricultural Income-tax Act, 1955 permits deduction of expenditure, other than capital expenditure or personal expenses, laid out wholly and exclusively for the purpose of the plantation. Because its test was the same as, and in its closing words more favourable than, the test in section 5(j) of the Travancore-Cochin Agricultural Income-tax Act, 1950, the Court applied Travancore Rubber & Tea Co. Ltd. v. Commissioner of Agricultural Income-tax, Kerala, [1961] 3 S.C.R. 279, which decided the deductibility of expenses for work on immature rubber trees.

rule.if: agricultural_tax_deduction_appeal and immature_rubber_upkeep_expense and wholly_for_plantation and not capital_or_personal_expense and deduction_test_no_narrower_than_controlling_test

predicates.agricultural_tax_deduction_appeal: The proceeding is an appeal concerning whether an expense may be deducted in an agricultural-income-tax assessment.
predicates.immature_rubber_upkeep_expense: The assessee incurred an expense to maintain or tend immature, non-bearing rubber trees.
predicates.wholly_for_plantation: The expense was laid out wholly and exclusively for the purpose of the plantation.
predicates.not capital_or_personal_expense: The expense was neither capital expenditure nor a personal expense of the assessee.
predicates.deduction_test_no_narrower_than_controll: The applicable test for deducting plantation expenses is no narrower than the test applied in the controlling decision on expenses for tending immature rubber trees.

issues.definition: When an agricultural-income-tax deduction appeal concerns qualifying expenses for maintaining immature rubber trees and the applicable deduction test is no narrower than the controlling test, the expenses are deductible.
